description: This header file declares a function `ExtractCvdArgs` which processes command-line arguments to extract 'cvd' related arguments before a subcommand, as part of the `cuttlefish` namespace. It includes relevant utility and type headers and contains licensing information.

methods.name: ExtractCvdArgs
methods.description: A function that extracts `cvd` arguments from a list of command-line arguments and removes them from the original list, returning a `Result` containing the remaining arguments.
